document.notes: Amounts REQUIRED to be paid under a suit, order or agreement — not amounts paid, and not deductions. Whether any part (restitution, remediation, compliance) is deductible is a section 162(f) question for a business, decided outside this form.

extraction.note: No structured model is bound: no Azure prebuilt-tax model for this form is recorded anywhere in this repo (schema, notes or the 068 model re-verification), and a model name is never guessed. The page is read by the generic reader.
